title: Pedestrian path minimum 1 m wide (apartments on a communal street)
text: For apartments that are served by a communal street, a pedestrian path is provided as follows: i. minimum 1m wide, clear of any utilities or minor projections;

replaces.note: Part B C6.1-C6.3: 1.2 m path for 10+ dwellings -> 1 m; 2.5 m separation from major openings dropped

notes: diverges: from ch3 C3.7.11(i); Chapter 4 Part 1 C3.7.11 (p41) applies to any apartments served by a communal street, with no 10-dwelling threshold, so the site.communal_street_serves_lots condition is removed. Width clear of utilities and minor projections.

verified.note: No dwelling-count threshold on this page.
